alerts.reason: Consolidated net sales growth slowed from 16.03% YoY in September to 7.70% in December (A and historical sales). Higher selling prices supported audio sales as smartphone units fell (B). Higher prices and content gains also supported mixed-signal sales as smartphone battery and power product sales fell (D). A slowdown of roughly eight percentage points per quarter would put the intervening quarter near flat and the target quarter beginning March 26 below −5.00% YoY.
